interface.name: mx_foreign_toplevel_info_manager_v1

description.summary: more about the toplevels a shell lists

interface.description: This interface lets a privileged shell client learn more about the toplevels zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1 lists: which process each belongs to and whether it is a modal dialog.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager object. Info objects already created stay valid.

request.name: get_info

description.summary: get the info for a toplevel

request.description: Create an info object for a toplevel handle. Its initial events are sent right away, followed by a zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.done that applies them. A handle that was already closed gets an inert info object that sends nothing.

interface.name: mx_foreign_toplevel_info_v1
interface.description: Like the handle's own events, these are double-buffered: they apply with the handle's next zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.done. Once the handle is closed, the object is inert.

event.name: pid

description.summary: the process the toplevel's client is

event.description: Sent once, at creation. 0 if the compositor does not know.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: process id, in the compositor's pid namespace

event.name: modal

description.summary: whether the toplevel is a modal dialog

event.description: Sent at creation and whenever it changes. A modal dialog blocks input to its parent, as xdg_dialog_v1.set_modal asks.
